answer: Sybil resistance follows when trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph: honest mass mixes across well-connected regions, while a Sybil cluster is separated by a sparse external cut of low conductance. Conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds limit the probability that walks enter or remain in that cluster, thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight despite many identities. Naming vertices knoll, delta, or yarrow cannot change this structural limit.
